name: Liberty City
description: A recurring city that shifts from early top-down streets to the 3D-era island layout and the modern Liberty City of Grand Theft Auto IV.
map_note: World layouts differ across titles and eras.

name: Vice City
description: The series’ neon coastal city appears in multiple eras, with a modern-day return in Grand Theft Auto VI.
map_note: Vice City in each game is its own world layout; this guide does not reproduce official in-game maps.

name: San Andreas
description: The name spans different game worlds: the 1992 state in San Andreas and the later Los Santos and Blaine County setting in Grand Theft Auto V.
map_note: Locations and boundaries are different between games.

name: London
description: The two London expansions move the series to a 1960s setting and a distinct top-down city layout.
map_note: A community reference to the two original expansions.

name: Anywhere City
description: The setting for Grand Theft Auto 2, divided into distinct districts and presented from a top-down perspective.
map_note: A community reference, not an official interactive map.

name: Leonida
description: The announced setting for Grand Theft Auto VI, including a return to Vice City and locations across the state.
map_note: Official game details may change before release; consult Rockstar for current information.
